text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Close to 750 MPLA delegates from around the country started arriving in the capital for the beginning of the party conference. Conferences usually take place in preparation for Party Congresses. The last Party Congress was held in 1992.
- The newspaper reports that "pirates" or illegal fisherman have been robbing the nurseries of fisheries at a large fish farm about 70 km south of Luanda.
